items.sentence: The second edition of a large dictionary, published in 1987 in U.S., ___ an extensive change, with thousands of new words and most of its entries revised or updated.
items.prompt: 문장 전체의 본동사로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
items.explanation: published in 1987 in U.S.는 주어 뒤에 삽입된 과거분사구이고, 문장 전체의 본동사는 underwent입니다.

items.sentence: The second edition of a large dictionary, published in 1987 in U.S., underwent an extensive change, with thousands of new words and most of its entries revised or updated.
items.prompt: 주어를 수식하는 과거분사구와 with구문의 목적격보어를 차례로 선택하세요.
items.explanation: published ...는 The second edition을 수식합니다. with의 목적어 most of its entries와 목적격보어는 수동 관계이므로 revised or updated가 쓰였습니다.

items.sentence: Modern biology is as important as it is inspiring, with exciting breakthroughs changing our very society; biology has even entered criminal investigations, with terms such as DNA fingerprinting now being part of our vocabulary.
items.prompt: 두 with구문에서 목적격보어 역할을 하는 분사구를 차례로 선택하세요.
items.explanation: exciting breakthroughs와 changing은 능동 관계이고, terms와 being도 능동 관계이므로 각각 현재분사구가 목적격보어로 쓰였습니다.
items.memory: with + O + v-ing/p.p.: 목적어와 보어의 능동·수동 관계를 확인

items.sentence: Modern biology is as important as it is inspiring, with exciting breakthroughs changing our very society.
items.prompt: ‘많은 노력 끝에 오는 획기적인 발견이나 발전’의 뜻을 가진 단어를 입력하세요.

items.sentence: While the general education level of tourists traveling abroad continues to rise, tourists are still confronted with challenges when visiting a foreign country.
items.prompt: when visiting a foreign country에서 visiting의 의미상의 주어는 누구인가요?
items.explanation: when visiting은 분사구문이며 visiting의 의미상의 주어는 주절의 주어 tourists와 같습니다.

items.sentence: Although accustomed to the ups and downs of the ordinary economic cycle, elected officials and budget planners are facing something none of them have experienced before: shortfalls happening year after year.
items.explanation: Although accustomed ...는 being이 생략된 분사구문이며, 의미상의 주어는 주절의 elected officials and budget planners입니다.

items.sentence: Although accustomed to the ups and downs of the ordinary economic cycle, elected officials and budget planners are facing something none of them have experienced before: shortfalls happening year after year.
items.answer: none of them have experienced before
items.explanation: 목적격 관계대명사 which/that이 생략된 none of them have experienced before가 something을 수식합니다.

items.sentence: Bertoldo di Giovanni is a name even the most enthusiastic lover of art is unlikely to recognize. The greatest sculptor of his time, he was the teacher of Michelangelo, the greatest sculptor of all time.
items.prompt: The greatest sculptor of his time 앞에 생략된 것으로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
items.explanation: The greatest sculptor of his time는 앞의 Being이 생략된 분사구문으로 볼 수 있으며 의미상의 주어는 he, 즉 Bertoldo di Giovanni입니다.
